description: This file defines the OcsAPI interface for interacting with the Nextcloud Deck REST API, including methods for retrieving capabilities and user information, using Retrofit HTTP annotations and RxJava support.

classes.name: OcsAPI
classes.description: Interface for accessing Nextcloud Deck capabilities and user data via REST API.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of the Nextcloud Deck server, with support for ETag conditional GET.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches the user details by user ID.
